scenarios.name: Russia-Ukraine Conflict De-escalation
scenarios.description: A diplomatic resolution to the Ukraine conflict reduces energy and supply chain disruptions, lowering inflationary pressures.

impacts.explanation: Reduced energy prices and stabilized supply chains lower cost pressures.
Investor confidence rises, increasing demand for long-term bonds.

scenarios.reasoning: Diplomatic efforts historically reduce prolonged conflicts, but escalation risks remain low due to NATO involvement.
tetlockCommandments: Strike the right balance between inside and outside views

scenarios.name: AI-Driven Productivity Surge
scenarios.description: Widespread adoption of AI in manufacturing and services boosts industrial output and employment.

impacts.explanation: Automation increases efficiency, offsetting labor costs.

scenarios.reasoning: Technological adoption curves suggest AI integration could accelerate post-pandemic productivity gains.
tetlockCommandments: Break seemingly intractable problems into tractable sub-problems

scenarios.name: Federal Debt Ceiling Crisis
scenarios.description: Congress fails to raise the debt ceiling, leading to fiscal austerity measures and reduced government spending.

impacts.explanation: Spending cuts directly reduce debt accumulation.
Public sector layoffs and reduced stimulus hurt job growth.

scenarios.reasoning: Political polarization increases the likelihood of deadlocks over fiscal policy.
tetlockCommandments: Strike the right balance between under- and overreacting to evidence

scenarios.name: Global Trade War Escalation
scenarios.description: Majority of trading partners impose new tariffs on U.S. exports, worsening the trade deficit.

impacts.explanation: Higher imported goods prices reduce consumer purchasing power.

scenarios.reasoning: Geopolitical tensions (e.g., US-China rivalry) historically correlate with trade policy volatility.
tetlockCommandments: Look for the clashing causal forces at work in each problem

scenarios.name: Labor Market Cooling
scenarios.description: Persistent high interest rates reduce hiring, particularly in tech and manufacturing sectors.

impacts.explanation: Reduced job creation offsets current low unemployment trends.
Slowing hiring exacerbates labor shortages in key industries.

scenarios.reasoning: The Fed's anti-inflationary stance may prolong labor market cooling.
tetlockCommandments: Strike the right balance between under- and overconfidence

scenarios.name: Sudden Oil Price Spike
scenarios.description: Geopolitical tensions in the Middle East cause oil prices to surge, hiking energy costs.

impacts.explanation: Energy costs dominate overall price indices.

scenarios.reasoning: Historical patterns show oil price volatility remains a significant risk factor.
tetlockCommandments: Look for the errors behind your errors

methodology: Applied Tetlock's pillars by combining probabilistic scenarios (pillar 1), base rate adjustments (pillar 2), and continuous monitoring of indicator trends (pillar 3). Commandments 2 (decomposition) and 3 (balance) guided scenario design.
geopoliticalSummary: Heightened tensions in Ukraine and Middle East pose risks to energy markets, but diplomatic channels remain active to mitigate escalation.
geoeconomicSummary: Persistent trade imbalances and dollar strength create vulnerabilities, though AI adoption may offset some pressures.
currentEventsSummary: Fed's hold on rates and labor market resilience contrast with rising debt and trade deficits, creating a mixed economic outlook.
